goal: Make Agent enablement product-ready without introducing a XiaoYu runtime/config/permission authority.

native_findings.finding: Native switch snapshot already exposes master enabled state, persisted sub-flags, model/API gate reasons, capability readiness, model-image readiness and HUD preference.
Read-only authenticated console route exposes the native switch snapshot without consuming a capability or changing state.
Read-only authenticated route exposes dsh supported/installed/downloading/error/preference/in-use/session state and plugin inventory. Install/uninstall remain separate explicit POST actions.
Read-only authenticated route exposes native PermissionStore version, unreadable state, categories, configured modes and resolved auto policy.
Native persisted intent is restored through the same set_agent_enabled/set_agent_flags code paths, preserving capability checks and user-visible auto-disable reasons instead of bypassing readiness.
Console power changes are already routed through the main server so sessions stay synchronized; a XiaoYu side-channel switch would duplicate authority.
Native UI already renders gate/capability reasons and maps console refusal codes; PowerBar waits for setPower and surfaces failures.

native_findings.surface: NekoClaw built-in runtime + dsh optional seam
native_findings.finding: Built-in runtime remains default. dsh is detectable and status-readable without installation; installation is an explicit user action and must not be performed by readiness probing.

reuse_order.reason: Already owns master switch, model/API gate, capability status, runtime status, permissions, restart intent and UI failure reasons.
Upstream main resolves to the pinned c3fc33ff commit; no newer readiness API needs migration.

reuse_order.candidate: N.E.K.O Plugin SDK / NekoClaw / MCP / native delivery
reuse_order.reason: Capability/plugin/MCP readiness remains owned by native host and permission gate; preflight must only observe those states.
No pinned connector is authoritative for Agent master or NekoClaw runtime readiness.
Introducing another orchestrator/readiness authority would violate the frozen single-runtime architecture and cannot improve native switch/capability truth.
The required information is already available through native read-only console surfaces; no adapter/state store/router/daemon is necessary.
No reproduced native acceptance gap currently requires a core patch.

acceptance_targets: master-off readiness inspection performs no state mutation
agent model/API configuration failures expose stable native reason codes
computer and browser capability readiness remains native and independently visible
permission store unreadable/version/modes are visible before execution
built-in runtime is usable without dsh
dsh missing is reported but never installed by preflight
restart intent re-enters the same native enable/capability gates
enable failure is surfaced to the product UI instead of silently toggling state
no XiaoYu switch store, permission store, runtime router, daemon or model probe is introduced
retirement_condition: Retire overlay readiness acceptance wiring when the pinned N.E.K.O release itself ships and gates an equivalent single product-level Agent readiness acceptance suite.
